_comment: Items the audit cannot measure (unknown background, unparsed colour, gradient text) that a person has checked by eye. summarize.mjs fails the gate for any such item not listed here. Entry: { kind: unknown|unparsed|gradientText, route: <routes.json label>, width?: 1280|375 (omit = both), text?: start of the text ('*' = every item of that kind on the route), selector?: exact selector, reason: why it cannot be measured, verifiedBy: who checked it, how (screenshot path, ratio read with a colour picker), and when }. Do not add entries without a by-eye check.

needsByEyeCheck.reason: Text sits over the animated starfield <canvas> on a dark radial gradient; measured against absent/black/white the result depends on the canvas pixels. Check the plan cards and the '/35'-'/45' alpha lines by eye, then sign off or fix.
